2608.13304.title: Refusing Intent, Not Form: Wrapper-Based Intent-Group Supervision for LLM Safety
2608.13304.paper_summary: Safety tuning can improve harmful refusal, but models may learn surface-form shortcuts: wrapped harmful prompts bypass safety, while similarly wrapped benign prompts are over-refused. We propose Wrapper-Based Intent-Form Augmentation (WIFA), an automatic intent-group augmentation method that pairs wrapped harmful examples with structurally matched wrapped benign counterexamples, requiring no external teacher or manual per-wrapper intent labels. We use WIFA as a common data layer for two complementary fine-tuning routes: WIFA-Boost, a two-stage high-safety recipe, and Anchored Group-Consistent Refusal Training (A-GCRT), which regularizes refusal/compliance decision scores across same-intent wrappers and anchors harmful and benign groups on opposite sides of a margin. In the Qwen setting, WIFA-Boost reaches the strongest transformed-harmful refusal, while A-GCRT reduces OR-Bench over-refusal from 25.7\% for the base model to 17.4\%; reproduced baselines do not match these operating points. Llama results and ablations over data structure, two-stage order, and A-GCRT components support this intent-group interpretation without claiming universal below-base over-refusal.
2608.13304.paper_summary_zh: 安全調整可以改善有害拒絕，但模型可能會學習表面形式的捷徑：包裝的有害提示繞過安全，而類似包裝的良性提示則被過度拒絕。我們提出了基於包裝的意圖形式增強（WIFA），這是一種自動意圖組增強方法，將包裝的有害範例與結構上匹配的包裝良性反例配對，無需外部教師或手動每個包裝的意圖標籤。我們使用WIFA作為兩條互補微調路徑的共同數據層：WIFA-Boost，一種兩階段高安全性的配方，以及錨定組一致拒絕訓練（A-GCRT），該方法在相同意圖的包裝之間正則化拒絕/遵從決策分數，並將有害和良性組別錨定在邊界的兩側。在Qwen設置中，WIFA-Boost達到了最強的轉化有害拒絕，而A-GCRT將OR-Bench的過度拒絕從基礎模型的25.7\%降低到17.4\%；重現的基準無法匹配這些操作點。Llama的結果和對數據結構、兩階段順序以及A-GCRT組件的消融支持了這一意圖組解釋，而不聲稱普遍低於基準的過度拒絕。
